hand_inspection_contact_cue: Find the rounded heel at the wrist end of the lower hand. The fingers sit above the chest in this model. The close-up keeps some chest visible around the heel.
hand_inspection_palm_cue: Look at the near hand: the palm folds face upward, while the nails are on the back. Compare the poses to follow its orientation as the body turns.
hand_inspection_palm_pending: The palm close-up is available when the shown pose includes the near-arm step.
hand_inspection_recoil_cue: Compare release and peak: the heel follows the chest in both positions. Contact alone does not show full recoil; compare the chest with the resting-height line and graph.
hand_inspection_scope: This is a visual model of hand position, not a measurement of pressure or contact force.
